task: positive-unlabeled ranking score for collagen/ECM-promoting peptides; mean P(active) across bags in [0, 1]
architecture: StandardScaler -> PCA (95% variance, 62 components) -> 500 bagged L2 logistic regressions (C=0.01, class_weight=balanced); each bag = all positives vs all negatives + 51 random unlabeled
esm_embedding: mean-pooled last_hidden_state over residue positions, BOS/EOS excluded

training_data.cv: StratifiedGroupKFold(5) on CD-HIT 90% identity clusters, repeated 20 times; scaler, PCA and C refit inside each training fold

cv_metrics.source: pipeline.ipynb, pooled out-of-fold scores over 20 repeats
